title: Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 27
native_title: フラッシュ・セガサターン Ｖｏｌ．２７
overview:
Flash SegaSaturn Vol. 27 is a free Japanese demo disc from Sega that collects a trial version and previews of Saturn games.

Playable demo:
- Kumitate Battle Kuttu Ketto (one player, or two players alternating)

Non-playable previews:
- Sakura Taisen 2: Kimi, Shinitamou Koto Nakare
- Shining Force III Scenario 2: Nerawareta Miko
- Shoujo Kakumei Utena: Itsuka Kakumei Sareru Monogatari
- Kidou Senshi Gundam: Gihren no Yabou
- Vampire Savior: The Lord of Vampire
- Bomberman Wars
- Super Robot Taisen F Kanketsuhen
